title: Trade Union Co
description: tradeunionco.com tuc-dxb.com Trade Union Co. is a family-owned automotive spare parts wholesaler and retailer founded in 1960 in Beirut, Lebanon, with over 65 years of experience serving customers across the Middle East, Africa, Europe, Asia and the Americas. The group operates through its Beirut headquarters and The Trade Union International LLC in Dubai, a 5000 square meter global re-export hub established in 2007 with offices also in Germany, Russia and Nigeria. With over 150 employees and 20 plus international aftermarket brands including Bosch, Mahle, ZF and Sachs, it supplies parts for European, Japanese and American passenger and commercial vehicles. Led by CEO Walid El Bissani and Head of Strategy Tarek Jamil, the company is a member of NEXUS Automotive International, the world's largest automotive distribution community. It regularly exhibits at Automechanika Dubai and Frankfurt, showcasing its growing brand portfolio and global logistics network.
